changes: Seven downloadable Catholic Bible editions (73 books each): Christian Community Bible, Douay-Rheims (Challoner), El Libro del Pueblo de Dios, La Biblia Latinoamericana, La Santa Biblia, Biblia Sagrada (PT), Nova Vulgata; picker grouped by language; data on branch bibles-data (a489579), sha256-verified per book.
Per-edition cross-references in each edition's own numbering (OpenBible.info, CC BY 4.0); 52/52 audit per edition.
Bundled cross-references fixed (Spanish psalms with different verse division, e.g. Gen 1:2 -> Ps 103:30; Jonah 1:17); audit 52/52 en/es/pt with regression tests.
rights: Project owner states the seven Bible texts are free to use with permission (2026-11-15); see docs/content/BIBLE-EDITIONS.md.
tests: manual sha256 check of live downloads
known_limitations: Edition picker not reviewed in a screenshot.
In ES/PT/LA editions verse placement inside a few chapters relies on length alignment and may be off by one in rare places.
